title: clinopodium tomentosum
intro: Clinopodium tomentosum, commonly known as Woolly Clinopodium or Woolly Mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea, and soothe the respiratory system. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium tomentosum include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help to calm digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
